finalResult.nextParagraphText: She continued to explain what had led to all this. All about seeing this Fortuna Ferret, the mound, the kits, and their desire to protect the young ones from the Simivita, who apparently liked to eat the children of powerful races with the thought they would get stronger. Based on what Jake knew about Records, it probably even worked to some extent, as genuine belief had power in its own right.
finalResult.previousParagraphText: Having already mentally prepared himself... Jake didn’t experience what he had thought would happen at all.
